easy.def: A dark shape made when something blocks the light.
examples: I can see my shadow on the wall.
My shadow is long in the evening.
The cat jumped at its own shadow.

more.def: A dark shape that forms when something blocks light.
examples: In the evening, the trees cast long shadows across the lawn.
The tall building cast a shadow over the park.
We made shadow animals on the wall with our hands.
We found shelter from the rain.
The cat found shelter under the porch.
The bus stop is a shelter from the wind.

more.def: A place that covers and protects people or animals from weather or danger.
examples: The hikers built a shelter out of branches before the storm.
The barn gave the cows shelter from the snow.
People who lost their homes stayed at a shelter.

easy.def: To shake because you are cold or scared.
examples: The scary story made me shiver.

more.def: To shake slightly because you are cold or frightened.
examples: We shivered at the bus stop in the icy wind.
The swimmers shivered as they climbed out of the lake.
He shivered when the cold wind blew down his neck.
